analysis: The only change in docs/developer/test.md is a one-line documentation edit at head lines 1049-1050. It updates the SDK 27 release qualification text to SDK 27.2, Swift 6.4.2 and Xcode 27.2, and links the `release` toolchain anchor in build.md. The supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 2299-3194) that sit outside the changed range, so they contain unchanged developer test documentation. I read them for context and found nothing the PR altered. The changed hunk adds no code, configuration, secret, endpoint or attestation or cache behavior. It does not touch the asset, boundary or threat entries in the model (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, T-041 and others), and no mitigation or assumption is weakened. The prefix-cache, tenant-partition and SSD-record sections in the supplied text are descriptive test instructions and are unchanged, so T-041's SSD tier posture is unaffected. One open point: the referenced build.md anchor and the real toolchain pin in CI or build scripts were not supplied, so I cannot confirm they match the documented 27.2 / 6.4.2 versions. That is a documentation-consistency question, not a security regression. No threat-model update is needed from this change.
